messages:
rachel_social: Hey team — final push for next-week launch social. Need help finalizing cadence + assets. :rocket:

maria_pm: Thanks — can we do a LinkedIn long post + X thread + 3 tweet image cards? Also want a short webinar CTA post the day before.

jonas_growth: +1. For benchmarking narrative we should call out: 60% lower per-token cost vs our previous rollout and <120ms median latency on Redwood Dedicated (non-nested). Can marketing phrase that without specs? :mag_right:

rachel_social: Keep it customer-facing: "Lower inference cost, consistent latency at scale" — avoid raw numbers in the hero post, but use numbers in the webinar/benchmark blog. For social, we can use one stat card image with the numbers.

sam_eng: I can export a small stat graphic and PNGs. Which dimensions do you need?

rachel_social: Need: 1200x627 (LinkedIn), 1080x1080 (X image cards), and a short 9s GIF showing inference latency chart. Also alt text for accessibility.

jonas_growth: Will create 3 variants of copy for A/B: 1) Product-forward, 2) Cost-focused, 3) Reliability-first. We'll test CTA clicks and comment engagement.

maria_pm: Routing: inbound leads from the webinar should hit Pardot with UTM: ?utm_source=social&utm_campaign=launch_q2. Kevin from sales will own follow-ups. Kevin can you confirm CRM flow?

kevin_sales: Confirmed. Pardot to Salesforce owner assignment by region. Also enable a low-touch SDR drip for <30 engagement score.

rachel_social: Scheduling: prefer the following windows for X thread split tests per timezone. If anyone has objections, flag now.

rachel_social: 1) US morning (9:30 PT) — long X thread + image card
2) EU early (10:00 BST) — single card + link to webinar registration
3) LinkedIn long post — Tue 10:00 PT (organic + boosted for PLG segment)
4) Webinar reminder — day before at 11:00 PT

jonas_growth: Can we try one organic post at 17:00 local for APAC segment on the last weekend push?

rachel_social: OK add APAC evening slot — Sat 17:00 SGT for LinkedIn pulse.

sam_eng: Uploading assets to the shared drive now: https://drive.internal/rw/launch-assets/1981234567 — includes PNGs, GIF, and the benchmark stat CSV.

socialbot: Scheduler queued: X thread draft (variant A) -> schedule 2026-04-14T16:30:00Z. Will post via Buffer unless instructed otherwise.

maria_pm: Copy drop below (shorten for X):
```
Variant A (Product-first):
Meet Redwood Dedicated — same API, predictable latency, and lower inference costs. Join our webinar to see the benchmarks in action. ▶️ https://redwood.ai/webinar

Variant B (Cost-first):
Cut inference spend without sacrificing speed. See how we do it in our launch webinar. Reserve your spot. ▶️ link
```

rachel_social: Great. Need someone to own comment engagement during the first 6 hours after posting (reply with prompt variants + links). Jonas?

jonas_growth: I'll take first 3 hours, then @kevin_sales will do handoff for demo invites. I'll prepare 6 quick reply templates (FAQ + CTA).

kevin_sales: I'll monitor replies and route demo requests. Can marketing pin a short form in the thread pointing to the Pardot landing page?

rachel_social: Yes — landing page link will be in the first comment. Also asking ops to enable lead webhook to Slack #sales-inbound.

sam_eng: Small ask: can we include a screenshot of the console latency dashboard for the blog? I cropped a high-res version to the drive. Anyone opposed?

maria_pm: Fine. Use a blurred API key overlay and callout text for the graph.

rachel_social: Action items:
- sam_eng: finalize assets + alt text (due: today EOD)
- jonas_growth: write reply templates + run A/B copy variants (due: tomorrow morning)
- kevin_sales: confirm Pardot -> SF routing + Slack webhook (due: EOD)
- rachel_social: schedule posts and pin landing page comment (doing now)

jonas_growth: Quick note on measurement: set UTM for each variant so we can attribute webinar signups -> specific post + time. I'll set a tracking sheet.

rachel_social: Perfect. If nobody objects I'll push variant A live for the X thread test tomorrow at 9:30 PT. :calendar: :thumbsup:

kevin_sales: Go for it. I'll standby for inbound.

maria_pm: No objections. Thanks everyone.

socialbot: Post successful: X thread (variant A) posted at 2026-04-14T16:30:03Z — ID 9876543210.
